messages.text:
"3D Creature Capture game with procedurally generated locations, must contain at least 4 Capital Cities with access to all ammenities, and each Capital City must have 3 outlying towns that have access to minimal ammenities. The game must contain creatures based on real life animals and insects, as well as mythological creatures. Must include 3 evolutions for every creature type, and 4 evolutions for the rarest creatures.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
